rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the goddess; aghora-mantra as the source of delight, samprītā as pleased
compound adjective describing the goddess; aghora-mantra as the means of worship, pūjitā as honored

items.question: What relationship does the goddess have with the Aghora mantra?
premises: The goddess is delighted by the Aghora mantra.
The goddess is worshipped through the Aghora mantra.
Both epithets characterize the same divine figure.
items.inference: The goddess is intimately connected to the Aghora mantra through both delight and ritual worship.
items.plain_english: She is delighted by the Aghora mantra and worshipped with the Aghora mantra.
